channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Stock futures tick higher ahead of busy week of earnings, jobs data and the midterm elections: Live updates
item.description: Investors geared up for another batch of earnings results and the upcoming midterm elections.

item.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack
item.description: Binance recorded $3.64 billion in net outflows after resuming withdrawals following a $6.3 billion hack, representing 2.1% of its total assets.

item.title: Democratic Rep. Stevens endorses Republican Rogers over rival El-Sayed in Michigan Senate election
item.description: Haley Stevens had lost the Democratic nomination for Senate in Michigan to Abdul El-Sayed earlier this year.

item.title: Judge dismisses Alaska Senate election lawsuit; DOJ vows appeal
item.description: Democratic nominee Mary Peltola is facing two candidates named Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate election, one of whom is the Republican incumbent.

item.title: Why AI is boosting Meta's ad business while hurting Google search
item.description: The gap between Meta's ad revenue growth and Google's search expansion was the widest it's been since 2021 in the latest quarter.

item.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy has stroke and is in the hospital, office says
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy's office announced Sunday that he suffered a stroke and was hospitalized the day prior, though they say he is 'awake and alert.'

item.title: Crocs stock jumped 25% after earnings. Here's why that might be just the beginning
item.description: Since CNBC flagged Crocs' depressed valuation on Oct. 13, the stock has surged 30%, fueled by a massive 25.5% post-earnings rally on Thursday.

item.title: For JPMorgan, Amazon, fighting AI bots like Meta Muse may not be a winning long-term strategy
item.description: As companies from Amazon to JPMorgan block AI personal agents like Meta's Muse, retail experts warn that technology that removes customer friction usually wins.

item.title: Trump defamation suit against Murdoch, WSJ over Epstein letter dismissed with prejudice
item.description: President Donald Trump denied writing a birthday letter to sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, which was the subject of a 2025 Wall Street Journal article.

item.title: ‘Pop-up’ super PACs pour $637 million into 2026 midterm races
item.description: Twenty-two late-forming super PACs spent about $637 million in 2026 congressional races, sometimes before voters could see their donors.

item.title: These Senate races may help determine the fate of Social Security
item.description: Social Security's retirement trust fund may run out in 2032. Senators elected this November will be in office when that deadline comes.

item.title: Social Security may have to cut retirement benefits in six years. Here's how much money is at stake for beneficiaries
item.description: The latest projections show Social Security may have to cut retirement benefits in six years. Here's what may happen if Congress doesn't prevent that.

item.title: Automatic 401(k) rollovers reduce cash-outs, research finds — but few accounts reach new employer plans
item.description: Workers with small 401(k) balances are cashing out less often under an automatic portability program, but most accounts remain in temporary IRAs.

item.title: Gen Z is ditching bars for run clubs — and finding more than friends along the way
item.description: As young adults denote less wallet share to bars, run clubs, races and recreational leagues become increasingly popular places to build community.

item.title: Bank of America says buy these stocks ahead of earnings before it's too late
item.description: The firm named a slew of undervalued stocks to buy ahead of quarterly reports.

item.title: The midterm election could reshape the muni bond market. Here’s what investors need to know
item.description: The 2026 election could affect municipal bonds through state tax measures, new bond supply and the makeup of Congress.

item.title: Anthropic's path to the Nasdaq just got a lot bumpier
item.description: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.

item.title: Crypto industry pours more than $200 million into 2026 midterms to pressure Congress on favorable rules
item.description: Interest groups tied to cryptocurrency are spending millions to tilt the midterm elections. They had mixed success in 2024

item.title: Top Wall Street analysts are bullish on these 3 stocks for the long haul
item.description: Investors looking beyond short-term noise and focusing on long-term returns can track top analysts to pick the right stocks, backed by strong research.

item.title: Companies promised AI gains — here's how the payoff showed up in earnings
item.description: Santander, Novartis and other companies say AI is beginning to boost revenue, cut costs or improve profitability as investors seek returns.

item.title: Automakers like Rivian and Ford are ‘democratizing 3D printing’ to reduce costs and increase speed
item.description: Automakers including Ford, Rivian and GM are expanding 3D printing to make prototypes, factory tools and low-volume parts faster and at lower cost.

item.title: The best high-yield savings accounts of November 2026: Earn up to 5.0%
item.description: Earn the most interest with our top-rated high-yield savings accounts.

item.title: OPEC+ keeps December oil output targets steady ahead of tougher call for 2027
item.description: While Gulf members have been boosting exports disrupted for months by the conflict, most are still pumping well below their targets.

item.title: Treasury Department announces new Series I bond rate of 5.51% for the next six months
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has announced new Series I bond rates through April 2027.

item.title: Binance’s $6.3 billion hack raises questions about crypto wallet safety
item.description: Two high-profile security incidents this week, including the largest crypto theft in history, have raised custody and safety concerns.

item.title: SpaceX loses bid to toss NAACP lawsuit over Memphis data center air pollution
item.description: The Colossus data centers and a power plant that SpaceXAI is also building in Southaven, Mississippi, have faced community backlash for years.

item.title: I'm a psychologist who studies couples: People in the happiest relationships do 1 thing differently after time apart—whether it's hours, days or weeks
item.description: Psychologist Mark Travers argues that the first few minutes after time apart are key to a close, happy relationship, and shares five tips to get them right.

item.title: Iran, Qatari mediators hold third day of talks to end U.S.-Iran war
item.description: The talks come amid concerns that the conflict could escalate again after the Nov. 3 U.S. midterm elections.

item.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
item.description: The funding round is still in progress and has not closed, so the figures are subject to change, a person directly familiar with the deal told CNBC.

item.title: Trump promised to slash energy costs — but gasoline, diesel and jet fuel all soared instead
item.description: President Donald Trump promised voters who were angry about inflation that he would slash gasoline prices below $2 a gallon in his first year in office.
